items: 400 g, rinsed and drained canned chickpeas

steps: Fry the chopped red onion and garlic in a little olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander and cinnamon and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the red pepper, courgette, aubergine and tomatoes, and cook for 8-10 minutes until coated in the spices and starting to brown.
Add the chickpeas, stock, harissa and prunes. Season, then simmer for 15-20 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Scatter with chopped flat-leaf parsley and serve with steamed couscous.
